new_result.statement: If A=sum lambda_i u_i u_i^T and C=sum t_i lambda_i u_i u_i^T with 0<=t_i<=1, then CR>=0 for R=A-C and A^2-C^2>=0. Hence s_j(AP)>=s_j(CP) for every original-coordinate isometry P. In particular under s3(A)>=1, clipping three chosen large eigenvalues to signed unit magnitude and deleting all others yields A^2>=P_E for their rank-three spectral projection.
new_result.scope: Deterministic square/carrier monotonicity only; not density monotonicity. Transfers completed receiver hypotheses monotone in A^2; does not itself create an original-coordinate paid certificate from rank-three geometry.

partner_result_applied.application: For M=CP and N=(A-C)P, K=G^{-1/2}P^T C(A-C)P G^{-1/2} is PSD, so the partner zero-spend inequality gives s_m(AP)^2 >= g^2 s_m(I+K)^2+s_m(Z)^2 >= g^2.

density_receiver_applied.application: Seven Bell-pair spectral modes with arbitrary signs/magnitudes >=1 and arbitrary spectator spectrum have certificate P_U<=A^2 with P_U[H,H]=(1/2)I_7. Parameters m=7,s=1,g^2=1/2,b=7/10,a=23/1000,kappa=31/3000 give ||p_Q||_essinf <999.

unresolved_implication: After exact clipping, the deterministic core is a signed rank-three partial isometry C with C^2=P_E. Need a universal product-preserving structural argument that every orientation of rank-three E activates a paid original-coordinate receiver; existing corrections exclude a universal single good minor or rank-three cross-cut dichotomy.
next_step: Exploit the exact normalized rank-three projection P_E: combine heavy-coordinate/ridge-window cases with grouped-coordinate aggregation for the complementary diffuse regime, preserving original-coordinate independence.
